description: This file defines the 'CategoryOptions' entity class used in the Android application for managing category options within the notes app. It includes annotations for Room persistence, foreign key constraints, and indexing, as well as getter, setter, equals, and hashCode methods.

classes.name: CategoryOptions
classes.description: Entity class representing category options for a user account, including sorting preferences and category name.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID associated with this category option.

methods.name: setAccountId
methods.description: Sets the account ID for this category option.

methods.name: getSortingMethod
methods.description: Returns the sorting method for the category, if any.

methods.name: setSortingMethod
methods.description: Sets the sorting method for the category.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare CategoryOptions instances based on accountId, category, and sortingMethod.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash based on accountId, category, and sortingMethod.
